newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: POLL-Analysts positive on RHI post H1 data.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Analysts positive on RHI post H1 data.

text.p: Most analysts polled by Reuters on Friday said they were leaving their earnings forecasts for industrial group RHI unchanged in the wake of first-half earnings data.
On Thursday, RHI said its group pre-tax profit rose six percent to 220 million schillings in the first half and net profit increased 14 percent to 174 million schillings.
"I am pretty satisfied, although my six-month estimates were a little higher. Things look pretty good," said Alfred Reisenberger of IMI Sigeco.
Gerhard Fleischer, an analyst at Bank Gutmann, agreed the first half figures were slightly disappointing, but pinpointed earnings potential in continuing restructuring.
Creditanstalt Investment Bank (CAIB) raised its RHI share price target for the next 12 months to 650 schillings from 620.
"The second quarter was heading in the right direction," said CAIB analyst Folker Wintersberger.
Investmentbank Austria upped its earnings per share estimates.
NOTE - Previous estimate in brackets -- Gabriele Kolar, Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
